normalValidation.validation: 592 pixels / 37 distributed BC5 blocks: original R/G match within 1; inverted G hypothesis rejected

formula.vertexTangentFrame: For static meshes: Blocal=cross(Nlocal,Tlocal)*localHand; Tcorrected=cross(Blocal,Nlocal)*localHand. Build noScaleWorld by dividing each finalWorld basis axis by its positive length (retain negative-axis sign). VS T=noScaleWorld*Tcorrected, N=noScaleWorld*Nlocal, hand=original tangent sign*primitive determinant sign. No inverse-transpose and no output-vector normalization. For original UE instanced path its matrix axes are individually normalized before the same transform; exact original instance sign policy is separately recorded.
formula.position: absoluteUEcm = 100 * worldPositionRHmeters.xzy + originUEcm; q = absoluteUEcm / worldScaleUEcmNegative
formula.sourcePreViewTranslation: Original PS: TEXCOORD9 translated world position minus View.PreViewTranslation (cb0[70].xyz). Web absolute world position already excludes camera translation; do not subtract camera position. Use final world position after every actor/instance transform.
formula.normalCoordinates: T=v0.xyz and N=v1.xyz are unnormalized linear-centroid pixel interpolants of original world tangent/normal. B=cross(N,T)*v1.w is rebuilt per pixel; do NOT normalize T,N,B before weight/projection math. Convert the correct original Web RH basis by .xzy; preserve reflection and instance determinant handedness.
formula.normalProjection: a=decode(q.xz); b=decode(q.yz); c=decode(q.xy); nxz=vec3(-a.x,a.z*N.y,-a.y); nyz=vec3(b.z*N.x,-b.x,-b.y); nxy=vec3(-c.x,-c.y,c.z*N.z)
formula.normalIntensityOrthonormalEquivalent: Not valid generally for the original interpolated frame. Only mathematically valid for a proven orthonormal TBN: outUE=normalize(normalIntensity*W + (1-normalIntensity)*dot(N,W)*N)
formula.sampling: Texture RGB decoded using original SRGB state; alpha remains linear. Repeat wrap; original PNG rows unchanged. No green-channel flip for the explicit UE world normal projection.
formula.selectionEmissive: SelectionColor.rgb*SelectionColor.a; default zero; preserve if set

shaderRecovery.factorPolicy: Plugin writes final baseColor,roughness,metallic and worldNormal; do not reapply generic channels/factors to these roles.
limitations: Static original material operations, not lighting/postprocess equivalence.
World-aligned normal requires geometric original world normal and orthonormal tangent frame or full stated TBN formula.
Origin remains zero in current export; update originUEcm if future origin rebasing is introduced.
